scenes.narration: This game exists because of a complaint filed in 1687.

scenes.prompt: a dusty archive room in an old Japanese temple, wooden shelves stacked with rolled paper scrolls, dim warm lantern light, dust motes floating in a shaft of light, cinematic, highly detailed, muted earth tones
scenes.narration: In a temple archive outside Kyoto, there is a box of scrolls nobody has ever catalogued. Most of them are tax records. One of them is not.

scenes.prompt: an ancient Japanese scroll unrolled on a dark wooden floor, dense brush calligraphy, one corner burned away, lit by a single candle, moody dramatic lighting, highly detailed
scenes.narration: It is a formal complaint, filed by a courier named Sabu. The subject line, roughly translated, reads: the road is too long, and the shuriken are unreasonable.

scenes.prompt: a night road lined with hundreds of red torii gates receding into darkness, wet stone path, low mist, moonlight, atmospheric cinematic wide shot, deep shadows, highly detailed
scenes.narration: Sabu's job was to carry messages down a road lined with a thousand torii gates. His complaint lists the hazards in order. Gates. Rocks. And, quote, the throwing stars, which nobody will explain to me.

scenes.prompt: a huge ornate metal shuriken embedded deep in a cracked stone wall at night, moonlight glinting along the blade, faint red glow, dramatic low angle, cinematic, highly detailed
scenes.narration: The complaint was denied. The stated reason was that the throwing stars were a traditional feature of the road. Sabu ran it for eleven more years.

scenes.subject: ninja
scenes.title: Sabu
bullets: Carries nothing. **Speed is the whole job**
Three lanes: left, middle, right
He gets **faster the longer he survives** — not a reward
scenes.narration: So this is Sabu. He carries nothing, because the job is speed. The road is three lanes wide. And the longer he stays alive, the faster he runs, which is not something he asked for.

scenes.subject: shuriken
scenes.title: The Unexplained Throwing Stars
bullets: Spinning, waist height, **cannot be jumped**
Roughly sixty percent of everything out there
Still nobody will explain them
scenes.narration: The throwing stars hover at waist height and spin. You cannot jump them. They make up about sixty percent of everything on that road, and to this day, nobody will explain them.

scenes.subject: rock
scenes.title: Rocks
bullets: The only honest obstacle on the road
**Jump it.** That is the entire interaction
Sabu's complaint raises no objection to these
scenes.narration: The rocks are the only honest hazard out there. You jump them. That is the entire interaction. Notably, Sabu's complaint raises no objection whatsoever to the rocks.

scenes.subject: wall
scenes.title: The Wall
bullets: Blocks a lane **completely** — jumping does nothing
They arrive **two at a time**, leaving one gap
You get about a second to pick
scenes.narration: Walls block a lane completely. Jumping does nothing at all. And they arrive two at a time, which leaves exactly one gap, and about one second to decide which one it is.

scenes.subject: boss
scenes.title: The Thing Behind You
bullets: Overtakes from **behind the camera**
Tuned so it can **never actually reach you**
It does not need to. It only has to be visible
scenes.narration: And then there is this. It comes up from behind you and sweeps past. Here is the honest part. It is tuned so that it can never actually reach you. It does not need to. It only has to be visible.

scenes.title: It Does Not Stay Calm
bullets: **SPEED SURGE** — the road stretches the whole view
**TRIPLE WALL** — two lanes shut at once
**BLACKOUT** — the lanterns go out for two seconds
scenes.narration: The road does not stay calm. It surges, and the entire view stretches out. Two lanes slam shut at the same time. And sometimes the lanterns simply go out, for two full seconds, while you are still running.

scenes.title: Every Run Ends the Same Way
bullets: Time **eases to a stop** instead of cutting
The camera pushes in as it happens
Then it tells you exactly how far you got
scenes.narration: Every run ends the same way. Time eases to a stop instead of cutting, the camera pushes in, and then it tells you exactly how far you got. Sabu ran this road for eleven years. You will last about forty seconds.
